title: Checkout API latency spike
summary: Checkout API became slow because Redis had no free connections in the pool. Users experienced 5-10 second response times during peak traffic.
root_cause: Redis connection pool exhausted. Pool size was 64 but concurrent connections peaked at 200+.
fix: Increase Redis connection pool size from 64 to 128. Set idle connection timeout to 30 seconds.

title: Kafka brokers unavailable
summary: Kafka brokers went down causing message queue backup. All event-driven services stopped processing. Producer queues filled up and started dropping messages.
root_cause: Kafka brokers crashed due to disk space exhaustion. Log retention policy was set too high.
fix: Restart Kafka brokers. Reduce log retention from 7 days to 24 hours. Add disk space monitoring alerts.

title: CPU spike in payment service
summary: Payment service CPU usage hit 100% causing request timeouts. The service was stuck in an infinite retry loop calling a downstream API.
root_cause: Infinite retry loop in payment gateway client. Exponential backoff was not implemented. Each failed request spawned 3 retries.
fix: Add exponential backoff with max 3 retries. Add circuit breaker pattern. Set retry delay to 1s, 2s, 4s.

title: Database connection timeout
summary: Primary PostgreSQL database became unreachable. All services experienced connection timeouts. Read replicas continued working but lagged behind.
root_cause: Database connection pool maxed out at 100 connections. Long-running analytical queries were holding connections for minutes.
fix: Move analytical queries to read replicas. Increase connection pool to 200. Add query timeout of 30 seconds.

title: Worker pods OOM killed
summary: Background worker pods were repeatedly OOM killed by Kubernetes. Job processing stopped and queue depth grew to millions.
root_cause: Memory leak in image processing worker. Large images were not being garbage collected. Heap grew to 4GB before OOM.
fix: Fix memory leak by explicitly releasing image buffers after processing. Set memory limit to 2GB. Add horizontal pod autoscaler.
